package_info.why_malicious: The package contains a setup.py payload that performs extensive anti-analysis checks (virtual machine, sandbox, known usernames, known IPs), then downloads and executes a trojan binary, and exfiltrates installation results via a Discord webhook. These behaviors are designed to evade detection and compromise victim systems.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Performs anti-analysis checks (OS, VM, sandbox, username, IP), then downloads and executes a trojan binary, and sends a notification to a Discord webhook.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code is heavily focused on evading analysis environments and only executes its payload on real victim systems. It downloads and executes a trojan, and exfiltrates data to an attacker-controlled Discord webhook.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: setup.py should only contain installation logic, not anti-analysis checks, network exfiltration, or trojan download/execution.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate software may check for virtualization for licensing or performance reasons, but not in combination with trojan download and Discord exfiltration.
key_indicators: Anti-VM and anti-sandbox checks in setup.py
Network request to public IP detection service
Download and execution of external binary

attack_chain.action: setup.py executes on install, performing anti-analysis checks (OS, VM, sandbox, username, IP).
attack_chain.leads_to: If all checks pass, proceeds to next step.

attack_chain.action: Downloads and executes a trojan binary from a rogue server.
attack_chain.leads_to: System compromise and remote code execution.

attack_chain.action: Sends a notification to a Discord webhook with installation result.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker is notified of successful compromise.

behavioral_signatures: setup.py or install scripts performing anti-VM or anti-sandbox checks
Network requests to public IP detection services during install
Download and execution of binaries from external servers at install-time
Exfiltration of installation results via Discord webhooks
file_indicators: setup.py containing obfuscated or conditional logic
References to public IP detection services (e.g., wtfismyip.com)
network_indicators: Requests to wtfismyip.com or similar IP-checking services during install
Outbound connections to Discord webhook endpoints
Download requests to non-standard or suspicious domains during install
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor install-time scripts (e.g., setup.py) for anti-analysis logic, network requests to public IP services, and attempts to download and execute binaries. Flag any exfiltration to Discord webhooks or other messaging platforms. Use static and dynamic analysis to detect obfuscated or conditional payloads in installation scripts.
